component: Account Hub calendar and address-book discovery candidates

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The original discovery change tries the email domain then incoming mail hostname in an ordered Set and stops at the first nonempty address-book list or calendar map. It does not merge results across hosts. Accepted source later builds candidates in the caller with a same-site check and a separate Graph case, then passes that list to both detectors. The caller still sequences address books and calendars around cancellation/skip work. Helper redirects, credential handling and server behavior remain unverified; required discussion gaps give this source lesson zero full-audit credit.
title: Related-account discovery returns the first nonempty host result and later centralizes host selection
